title: FRUIT SYRUP SAUCE
instructions: --One cup fruit syrup, one-half cup sugar, one teaspoon butter. Use the syrup from apricots, peaches, cherries, quinces or any fruit you prefer. The amount of sugar will depend upon the acidity of the fruit. Mix the corn starch with the sugar, add the syrup and boil all together five minutes. Add the butter last.
